integrity: Self-contained argument with standalone independent finite checks; no assertion of independent mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to 4-color, threshold-one, synchronous undirected finite rings of length at least three.
Does not enumerate transient orbits or attraction basins.
The 1990 original complete text and portions of early literature could not be inspected, so archival priority is qualified.
Independent mathematical review has not been performed.
title: Complete temporal orbit census for the four-color cyclic cellular automaton on rings
